description: This Java class implements a custom JSP tag `StoreBreadcrumbsTag` responsible for rendering breadcrumb navigation links based on the current request context. It retrieves breadcrumb data from the request, processes category identifiers, and outputs URL references for breadcrumb navigation.

classes.name: StoreBreadcrumbsTag
classes.description: Custom JSP tag class for rendering breadcrumb URLs based on request attributes and category identifiers.

methods.name: doStartTag
methods.description: Main method invoked at the start of tag processing; constructs breadcrumb URL reference string based on request attributes and class properties, then writes it to output.

methods.name: parseBreadCrumb
methods.description: Parses breadcrumb URL references to extract category IDs into a list.

methods.name: doEndTag
methods.description: Called at the end of tag processing; returns EVAL_PAGE to continue evaluating the rest of the page.
